directory.name: Saturn
directory.blurb: Saturn is a digital-credit protocol built on Monad. Deposit into USDat, a U.S. Treasury Bill–backed stablecoin with no lock-up, or stake into sUSDat for yield. Verified strategies route deposits across leading protocols to accrue points toward the seasonal emission pool.

directory.name: XStable

directory.name: Strata
directory.tagline: Structured yield products, engineered for tailored risk-reward
directory.blurb: Strata is a risk-tranching protocol that splits any yield strategy into two liquid tokens: a Senior tranche for capital preservation with a floored, protected yield, and a Junior tranche for leveraged, higher-yield exposure. On Monad, it brings structured, fixed-rate yield to assets like srUSDat.

directory.name: CoinFello
directory.tagline: Your Always On DeFi Super Agent.
directory.blurb: The first agent with full onchain context for research, execution, or automation any contract. The agent can do complex cross-chain token swaps to advanced automated management of yield and LP positions.

directory.name: USDC Bridge
directory.tagline: Circle's USDC Bridge enables you to directly move USDC across chains
directory.blurb: The USDC Bridge is a consumer-facing app built by Circle using CCTP. It gives users a direct and transparent way to move USDC across supported blockchains through a simple, transparent interface

directory.name: Collective Memory
directory.blurb: Collective Memory is a decentralized social network and "memory layer", a living archive of authentic moments captured by people worldwide. Users post real events as photos, videos, and text ("Memories"), verified by time and location, and stake the ATTN token on the content they think matters. Community attention, not corporate algorithms, decides what surfaces, and creators and early supporters earn when the moments they back gain relevance.

directory.name: Oripa
directory.blurb: Oripa brings the thrill of oripa — Japanese-style trading-card gacha — fully on-chain. Buy digital packs, open them live, and pull authentic, PSA-graded collectibles like Pokémon cards. Keep what you pull or sell it back instantly at market value, with every opening settled transparently on Monad.

directory.name: 1inch
directory.tagline: Swap crypto tokens at the best rates in DeFi
directory.blurb: 1inch is a DEX aggregator that sources liquidity from hundreds of exchanges to find the best swap rates in DeFi. It routes each trade across multiple liquidity sources for optimal execution, with gasless, MEV-protected swaps on Monad and other supported chains.

directory.name: AnomaPay
directory.blurb: AnomaPay is a crypto payments app for private transactions, making it easy to pay anyone privately with any asset across Monad and other supported chains. Built on Anoma, it lets you send assets like USDC, USDT, and ETH while keeping your onchain history confidential. Features include a confidential payment card, MEV-resistant swaps, tokenized stocks, and paying contacts by email or through apps like Telegram and X — no new software required.

directory.name: Glider
directory.tagline: The automated investing app for anyone, anywhere.
directory.blurb: Glider is an automated onchain portfolio app that makes sophisticated investing accessible to anyone, anywhere. Fund with USDC and pick a curated portfolio — or copy one shared by another investor — and Glider automatically rebalances your allocation on a cadence you choose, across crypto, tokenized stocks, and tokenized gold. It's non-custodial, so your assets stay in your own smart wallet under revocable, limited permissions, while Glider handles the routing and rebalancing behind the scenes.

directory.name: o1 exchange
directory.blurb: o1 is an onchain "everything exchange" that brings token swaps, market discovery, and a no-code token launchpad together in a single app. Traders can swap assets, follow trending markets, and manage a portfolio, while creators can launch new tokens in seconds. o1 makes discovering, launching, and trading onchain assets simple from one interface.

directory.name: Crystal
directory.tagline: Fully onchain order book on Monad
directory.blurb: Crystal is a fully onchain central limit order book (CLOB) built on Monad. Traders keep self-custody while getting CEX-grade speed. Orders are placed, matched, and settled onchain, and a router picks between the order book and a backstop AMM for best execution.
